For desktop app users, logs are located at:
- **macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/celerp/celerp-data/logs/`
- **Windows:** `%APPDATA%\celerp\celerp-data\logs\`
- **Linux:** `~/.config/celerp/celerp-data/logs/`

Attach `api.log` and/or `ui.log` if relevant.
